result.instructions: Tools for Civo, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Civo data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run civo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run civo_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run civo_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. civo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: civo_list_regions
tools.title: List regions
tools.description: List the Civo regions available to the account, with which one is the default, whether each is out of capacity, and the features each supports (IaaS, Kubernetes, object store, load balancers, GPU, databases). A cheap way to confirm the API key works. Civo: GET /v2/regions.

tools.name: civo_get_quota
tools.title: Get account quota
tools.description: The account's limits and current usage: instances, CPU cores, RAM, disk, volumes, snapshots, public IPs, networks, firewalls and rules, load balancers, object storage and databases. Answers 'can I launch another one?'. Civo: GET /v2/quota.

tools.name: civo_list_charges
tools.title: List charges
tools.description: List billable usage for a period: each resource's product code, label, region, time span and hours (size_gb for volumes). The range may be at most 31 days; defaults to the start of the current month until now. Civo: GET /v2/charges.

from.description: Start, RFC 3339 (e.g. 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z). Defaults to the start of this month.

to.description: End, RFC 3339. Defaults to now. At most 31 days after `from`.

tools.name: civo_list_instance_sizes
tools.title: List sizes
tools.description: List the sizes (plans) that can be launched — instances, Kubernetes nodes and databases — with CPU cores, RAM, disk, transfer allowance and GPU. Civo: GET /v2/sizes.

region.description: Region code, e.g. LON1, NYC1, FRA1, PHX1 (see civo_list_regions). Defaults to CIVO_REGION; Civo resources are regional, so pass the region the resource lives in.

tools.name: civo_list_instances
tools.title: List instances
tools.description: List compute instances in a region, optionally filtered by tags. Paginated: returns {page, per_page, pages, items}. Passwords are redacted. Civo: GET /v2/instances.

region.description: Region code, e.g. LON1, NYC1, FRA1, PHX1 (see civo_list_regions). Defaults to CIVO_REGION; Civo resources are regional, so pass the region the resource lives in.

tools.name: civo_get_instance
tools.title: Get one instance
tools.description: Fetch one instance: status, size, CPU/RAM/disk, public and private IPs, network, firewall, tags, attached volumes and source image. Passwords are redacted. Civo: GET /v2/instances/{id}.

region.description: Region code, e.g. LON1, NYC1, FRA1, PHX1 (see civo_list_regions). Defaults to CIVO_REGION; Civo resources are regional, so pass the region the resource lives in.

tools.name: civo_list_kubernetes_clusters
tools.title: List Kubernetes clusters
tools.description: List the Kubernetes (K3s/Talos) clusters in a region with status, version, node pools, API endpoint and installed applications. Paginated: {page, per_page, pages, items}. Kubeconfigs are redacted. Civo: GET /v2/kubernetes/clusters.

region.description: Region code, e.g. LON1, NYC1, FRA1, PHX1 (see civo_list_regions). Defaults to CIVO_REGION; Civo resources are regional, so pass the region the resource lives in.

tools.name: civo_get_kubernetes_cluster
tools.title: Get one Kubernetes cluster
tools.description: Fetch one Kubernetes cluster: status, readiness, conditions, version and available upgrade, pools and their instances, network, firewall, CNI and installed marketplace apps. The kubeconfig is redacted. Civo: GET /v2/kubernetes/clusters/{id}.

region.description: Region code, e.g. LON1, NYC1, FRA1, PHX1 (see civo_list_regions). Defaults to CIVO_REGION; Civo resources are regional, so pass the region the resource lives in.

tools.name: civo_list_networks
tools.title: List networks
tools.description: List the private networks in a region: label, CIDR, whether it is the default network, status and nameservers. Civo: GET /v2/networks.

region.description: Region code, e.g. LON1, NYC1, FRA1, PHX1 (see civo_list_regions). Defaults to CIVO_REGION; Civo resources are regional, so pass the region the resource lives in.

tools.name: civo_list_firewalls
tools.title: List firewalls
tools.description: List the firewalls in a region with their network, rule count and how many instances, clusters and load balancers use each. Civo: GET /v2/firewalls.

region.description: Region code, e.g. LON1, NYC1, FRA1, PHX1 (see civo_list_regions). Defaults to CIVO_REGION; Civo resources are regional, so pass the region the resource lives in.

tools.name: civo_list_firewall_rules
tools.title: List a firewall's rules
tools.description: List the rules of one firewall: protocol, port range, CIDRs, direction (ingress/egress), action (allow/deny) and label — the answer to 'what is exposed to the internet?'. Civo: GET /v2/firewalls/{id}/rules.

region.description: Region code, e.g. LON1, NYC1, FRA1, PHX1 (see civo_list_regions). Defaults to CIVO_REGION; Civo resources are regional, so pass the region the resource lives in.

tools.name: civo_list_load_balancers
tools.title: List load balancers
tools.description: List the load balancers in a region: algorithm, backends (IP, protocol, source/target ports), public IP, state and the Kubernetes service each fronts. Civo: GET /v2/loadbalancers.

region.description: Region code, e.g. LON1, NYC1, FRA1, PHX1 (see civo_list_regions). Defaults to CIVO_REGION; Civo resources are regional, so pass the region the resource lives in.

tools.name: civo_list_volumes
tools.title: List volumes
tools.description: List the block-storage volumes in a region: size, status, type, and the instance or cluster each is attached to (unattached volumes still bill). Civo: GET /v2/volumes.

region.description: Region code, e.g. LON1, NYC1, FRA1, PHX1 (see civo_list_regions). Defaults to CIVO_REGION; Civo resources are regional, so pass the region the resource lives in.

tools.name: civo_list_databases
tools.title: List databases
tools.description: List the managed databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) in a region: software and version, size, nodes, IPs, port, network, firewall and status. Paginated: {page, per_page, pages, items}. Passwords are redacted. Civo: GET /v2/databases.

region.description: Region code, e.g. LON1, NYC1, FRA1, PHX1 (see civo_list_regions). Defaults to CIVO_REGION; Civo resources are regional, so pass the region the resource lives in.

tools.name: civo_list_dns_domains
tools.title: List DNS domains
tools.description: List the domains whose DNS Civo hosts for the account. Civo: GET /v2/dns.

tools.name: civo_list_dns_records
tools.title: List DNS records
tools.description: List the records of one hosted domain (name, type, value, priority, TTL), optionally filtered by type or name. Civo: GET /v2/dns/{domain_id}/records.

name.description: Only records with this name (e.g. www, or @ for the apex).

tools.name: civo_reboot_instance
tools.title: Reboot an instance
tools.description: Reboot one instance. `soft` (default) asks the OS to restart cleanly; `hard` cuts power and boots it again, like pulling the plug — use only when soft does not work. Causes brief downtime. Civo: POST /v2/instances/{id}/soft_reboots or /hard_reboots.

region.description: Region code, e.g. LON1, NYC1, FRA1, PHX1 (see civo_list_regions). Defaults to CIVO_REGION; Civo resources are regional, so pass the region the resource lives in.

tools.name: civo_stop_instance
tools.title: Stop an instance
tools.description: Power off one instance. Anything it serves goes offline until it is started again with civo_start_instance. A stopped instance is still billed. Civo: PUT /v2/instances/{id}/stop.

region.description: Region code, e.g. LON1, NYC1, FRA1, PHX1 (see civo_list_regions). Defaults to CIVO_REGION; Civo resources are regional, so pass the region the resource lives in.

tools.name: civo_start_instance
tools.title: Start an instance
tools.description: Boot a stopped instance. Undoes civo_stop_instance. Civo: PUT /v2/instances/{id}/start.

region.description: Region code, e.g. LON1, NYC1, FRA1, PHX1 (see civo_list_regions). Defaults to CIVO_REGION; Civo resources are regional, so pass the region the resource lives in.

tools.name: civo_set_instance_tags
tools.title: Set an instance's tags
tools.description: REPLACE the full tag list of one instance (tags are used for filtering and by load-balancer instance pools, so changing them can move an instance in or out of a pool). Pass the complete desired list; an empty list clears all tags. Civo: PUT /v2/instances/{id}/tags.

region.description: Region code, e.g. LON1, NYC1, FRA1, PHX1 (see civo_list_regions). Defaults to CIVO_REGION; Civo resources are regional, so pass the region the resource lives in.

tools.name: civo_create_firewall_rule
tools.title: Add a firewall rule
tools.description: Add one rule to a firewall — e.g. allow TCP 443 ingress from 0.0.0.0/0. This changes what is reachable on every instance, cluster and load balancer using the firewall, so prefer narrow CIDRs. Undo by deleting the rule in the Civo dashboard or CLI. Civo: POST /v2/firewalls/{id}/rules.

start_port.description: First port, e.g. "443". Required unless protocol is icmp.

end_port.description: Last port of a range. Omit for a single port.

cidr.description: Source (ingress) or destination (egress) CIDRs. Civo defaults to 0.0.0.0/0 — the whole internet.

label.description: A display name for the rule.

region.description: Region code, e.g. LON1, NYC1, FRA1, PHX1 (see civo_list_regions). Defaults to CIVO_REGION; Civo resources are regional, so pass the region the resource lives in.

tools.name: civo_create_dns_record
tools.title: Add a DNS record
tools.description: Add one record to a Civo-hosted domain. Live DNS changes propagate to the world; undo by deleting the record in the Civo dashboard or CLI. Civo: POST /v2/dns/{domain_id}/records.

name.description: The subdomain part, e.g. www, or @ for the apex.

value.description: An IP address, hostname or text value.

ttl.description: TTL in seconds; Civo's minimum and default is 600.
